articles.title: Virgin Media O2 launches Europe’s first Starlink direct-to-smartphone service
articles.summary:
British mobile operator Virgin Media O2 said it started offering satellite-to-smartphone connectivity in the United Kingdom Feb. 26, marking the first commercial deployment of Starlink’s Direct-to-Cell service in Europe.

articles.title: JPL 3D-Printed Part Springs Forward
articles.summary: Description With a simple motion, a jack-in-the-box-like spring designed at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory showed the potential of additive manufacturing, also known as 3D printing, to cut costs and complexity for futuristic space antennas. articles.title: Landsat 9: More Than Just A Picture
articles.summary: For over 50 years, the Landsat program has provided the longest continuous satellite record of Earth’s land surface from space. Landsat 9, launched in 2021, is the latest mission in this remarkable legacy.
